title: Enhanced Vision-Language Models for Diverse Sensor Understanding: Cost-Efficient Optimization and Benchmarking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on the novel VS-TDX benchmark, using multiple-choice visual question answering across non-RGB sensor modalities (thermal, depth, and X-ray images) to measure the models' reliance on superficial RGB-based visual priors instead of sensor-specific physical properties.
